task:
Research: What is the most popular resume layout / CV format in Indonesia? 

Focus areas:
1. Most common resume layouts used in Indonesia (chronological, functional, combination/hybrid, ATS-friendly, etc.)
2. Popular Indonesian job platforms' guidance on CV format (e.g., Jobstreet Indonesia, Indeed Indonesia, Kalibrr, Glints, LinkedIn Indonesia)
3. Design preferences specific to Indonesia (colors, photos, length — e.g., 1-page vs 2-page, whether a photo is expected)
4. ATS compatibility considerations relevant in Indonesia
5. Any data on what recruiters in Indonesia prefer (e.g., surveys, articles from Indonesian HR/recruitment blogs)

Deliver a concise, well-sourced research brief (with links) summarizing the findings. If data is scarce, say so explicitly and provide the best available evidence.
